description: This file defines the interface and class declaration for the LocalStore component, which interacts with an SQLite database to manage data entries, including opening databases, creating tables, setting limits, retrieving entries, removing entries, and adding entries within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace.

classes.name: LocalStore
classes.description: Implements the ILocalStore interface to manage local data storage in an SQLite database.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the database at the specified path.

methods.name: CreateTable
methods.description: Creates a new table with the given name.

methods.name: SetLimit
methods.description: Sets a record limit for the specified table.

methods.name: GetEntriesCount
methods.description: Retrieves the count of entries in a table starting from a position, up to a maximum count.

methods.name: GetEntries
methods.description: Fetches entries from a table starting from a position with a specified count.

methods.name: RemoveEntries
methods.description: Removes entries between specified start and end positions in a table.

methods.name: AddEntry
methods.description: Adds a new entry to the specified table.

methods.name: buildGetEventsQuery
methods.description: Constructs a SQL query string to retrieve events from a table.
